ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There are two main parts in the figure. On the left is an alkene fragment with an HO substituent, connected to R¹, R², and R³; on the right is an iodine-containing cyclic aryl reagent, with iodine connected to oxygen, a hydroxyl group, an epoxy atom, and an aromatic ring. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows, and not counting any bonds involving hydrogen. Then reasoning count: Count item by item according to the non-hydrogen bonds in the figure. The left fragment contains: C-O to HO, C-R¹, C=C, C-C to the carbon bearing substituents, C-R², C-R³, for a total of 6 non-hydrogen bonds. The right iodine reagent contains: I=O, I-OH, I-O ring bond, I-C to the aromatic ring, O-C carbonyl ring bond, C=O, carbonyl C-aryl C, and 6 C-C bonds in the benzene ring, for a total of 13 non-hydrogen bonds. The total is 6 + 13 = 19.
